description: This file defines the FormWebhookService class, which implements methods to emit webhooks related to form submissions, including immediate and delayed webhook scheduling.

classes.name: FormWebhookService
classes.description: A service class responsible for emitting form submission webhooks and scheduling delayed webhooks.

methods.name: emitFormSubmitted
methods.description: Emits a webhook when a form is submitted, with optional event type and context.

methods.name: emitFormSubmittedNoEvent
methods.description: Emits a webhook for form submission without a specific event type.

methods.name: scheduleDelayedFormWebhooks
methods.description: Schedules a delayed webhook for a form submission response, with optional redirect and delay.
